Answer: B
Reason: Healed varicella zoster virus pneumonia is classically characterized by multiple, small (1-3 mm), randomly distributed calcified nodules throughout the lungs; while the classifier and report did not explicitly detect these subtle findings, this specific morphological pattern distinguishes it from the spiculated or cavitary lesions of TB or histoplasmosis described in other options. *(guided by t000002)*
